text: How a web request gets served, from the browser to the database.
First, the browser asks D N S to turn the domain name into an address.
The C D N answers what it can, straight from an edge server near the user.
Everything else goes to a load balancer, which picks a healthy app server.
The app checks its cache first. Most reads end right here.
On a miss, it queries the database and fills the cache for next time.
Fast, because every layer does one job well.
